title: Braze AWS Partnership and AI Features Could Signal Growth
summary: Braze announces AWS integration and new AI-powered customer engagement tools. Analysts suggest the stock may be undervalued by 20% following the launch.
body_markdown:
#### 💡 TL;DR


- Braze officially launched AWS integration and AI-powered engagement tools designed to enhance marketing personalization at scale.
- Analysts estimate the customer engagement platform may be undervalued by approximately 20% following the product announcements.
- The new AI capabilities automate campaign optimization and predict customer behavior patterns in real-time across channels.


Braze, the customer engagement platform publicly traded as BRZE, has officially launched a strategic partnership with Amazon Web Services alongside new AI-powered marketing features. Officially released on October 10, 2026, the integration positions Braze to leverage[AWS infrastructure](https://emergent.sh/news/aws-physical-ai-platform-helps-companies) while deploying machine learning capabilities that automate campaign personalization and predict customer behavior at enterprise scale. Market analysts responding to the announcement suggest the stock may be undervalued by as much as 20%, citing the technical advantages and revenue potential of the combined offering.


## AWS Integration Architecture


The Braze-AWS partnership centers on deep infrastructure integration that enables customers to run customer engagement workloads directly within their existing AWS environments. This approach addresses data residency requirements and reduces latency for real-time personalization engines. Braze will utilize AWS services including Amazon SageMaker for model training, Amazon Kinesis for streaming data ingestion, and AWS Lambda for serverless campaign execution.


Enterprises currently managing customer data in AWS can now deploy Braze engagement tools without migrating datasets to external platforms. The integration supports private VPC deployments and maintains compliance with regional data sovereignty regulations, a critical capability for financial services and healthcare organizations operating under strict governance frameworks.


## AI-Powered Customer Engagement Features


Braze has introduced three core AI capabilities designed to automate marketing workflows and improve conversion metrics. The first feature, Predictive Churn, analyzes behavioral signals across email, mobile, and web channels to identify customers likely to disengage within specified time windows. Marketing teams can trigger retention campaigns automatically based on churn probability scores.


The second capability, Intelligent Send Time Optimization, uses machine learning to determine the optimal message delivery time for each individual customer based on historical engagement patterns. Early beta customers report open rate improvements of 15-30% compared to manual scheduling approaches. The third feature, Content Personalization Engine, generates dynamic message variants tailored to customer preferences, purchase history, and contextual signals without requiring manual A/B test configuration.


## Market Valuation and Growth Projections


Financial analysts covering Braze have revised price targets upward following the AWS and AI announcements, with several firms suggesting the current stock price does not reflect the platform's expanded addressable market. The integration with AWS provides access to the cloud provider's extensive enterprise customer base, while AI features address demand for automated marketing intelligence tools.


According to Simply Wall Street's discounted cash flow analysis, Braze shares may be trading approximately 20% below fair value when factoring in projected revenue growth from AWS partnerships and AI product adoption. The customer engagement software market is expected to grow at a compound annual rate exceeding 18% through 2029, driven primarily by enterprises replacing legacy marketing[automation](https://emergent.sh/glossary/what-is-automation) systems with AI-native platforms.


## Competitive Positioning


Braze competes directly with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, and Iterable in the customer engagement category. The AWS partnership provides architectural differentiation, particularly for organizations already committed to AWS infrastructure. Competitors including Salesforce maintain multi-cloud strategies but lack the depth of integration Braze has achieved with a single cloud provider.


The AI features released today match or exceed capabilities available in competing platforms, with Predictive Churn and Intelligent Send Time representing table-stakes functionality in 2026. Braze's differentiation lies in the seamless integration of these AI tools within existing customer data workflows rather than requiring separate data science platforms or external model deployment.


## What This Means


The Braze-AWS partnership and AI product launch represent a strategic inflection point for the company, combining infrastructure scalability with intelligent automation capabilities that address core enterprise marketing challenges. For investors, the analyst assessment of 20% undervaluation suggests potential upside if the platform captures meaningful market share among AWS-native enterprises. Marketing teams gain access to sophisticated personalization tools without requiring specialized machine learning expertise, lowering the barrier to AI adoption in customer engagement workflows. The success of this integration will likely depend on execution speed and the company's ability to demonstrate measurable ROI improvements compared to existing marketing automation investments.
